Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
While we're all talking about it. Does a vampire who pushes a vote
that costs a blood (i.e. PTO) through with an Awe that leaves him
empty fizzle his vote as it attempts to resolve before he has the
opportunity to play the Voter Captivation? It is my understanding
that it does.

Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr
XZealot
Archon of the Swamp

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
XZealot wrote:
> While we're all talking about it. Does a vampire who pushes a vote
> that costs a blood (i.e. PTO) through with an Awe that leaves him
> empty fizzle his vote as it attempts to resolve before he has the
> opportunity to play the Voter Captivation? It is my understanding
> that it does.

The cost of the PA card is paid when the action succeeds, before the referendum
(and it must be paid in order to start the referendum). So the blood paid
(already) for the PA card cannot be used to power Awe.

Messages.Author: Dasein
Messages.Body:


So say Stani is on one blood and attempts a PTO. Someone blocks her,
she plays form of mist at super to S:CE and continue the action. So
now no more successful block attempts are made, the action is
successful; Stani has to pay for the PTO but she can't. So the action
fizzles at this point?
And out of curiosity, would she gain a blood for perfectionist at this
point (assuming no reaction cards were played)?
